tiers.req: Mammoth Bitusk sacrificed in the Sacrifice tab: the first five lines are open.
Attack Wish and Cutting Edge Technology at 10 or more.
Jötunn Eye sacrificed (five more lines open), and Wish for Hardness high enough to reach about 1,300 physical defence with thorium gear, the Act 2 guide's target for Maevath.
Maevath's Horn sacrificed: the last five lines are open.
Attack Wish at 20 and Wish for Hardness at 20.
Attack Wish, Wish for Luck, Pray for Luck and Wish for Speed all at 20, the base cap (Wish for Speed ends there).
Attack Wish, Wish for Luck and Pray for Luck at 30 or more. Needs the cap raised past 20 by Engineer More Sacrifices (Runic Blueprint and Sun Scroll) or the Act 2 Hard card.
Attack Wish, Wish for Luck and Pray for Luck at 40 or more.
Attack Wish, Wish for Luck and Pray for Luck at 42 (max).

tables.title: Sacrifice rules
rows: For damage, one of each upgrade at a time is the mathematically best order. On 2026-09-09 the author wrote that its math predates the Hourglass and 4-star cards: the Hourglass gives lots of crit and no ATK%, so crit lines (Dice, Damage Abuse, Wish for Luck, Pray for Luck) lose value against ATK% lines.
Take Attack Wish to 20 before Wish for Hardness.
Early on, push Attack Wish (Helmet Helmet) and Cutting Edge Technology (Icy Needles) toward 10 before going further.
Aim to fell Ironwood in 1–2 hits by the time Cutting Edge Technology is at 10.
Attack Wish is a true multiplier. Multipliers apply after all flat and percent bonuses and stack on each other, so they are the strongest kind.

Each Act 2 boss drops its sacrifice item on every kill: Mammoth Bitusk, Jötunn Eye or Maevath's Horn. EvitaniaOnlineDB lists these as the items that open five lines each. It also says a one-time sacrifice of each boss's heart permanently raises the Bonfire by two levels. The wiki lists Mammoth Soul and Jötunn Soul, but no Maevath soul. Which item the Sacrifice tab asks for, and what Maevath gives the Bonfire, are unverified in game; check the tab before spending items.

Base cap is 20 and the top is 42: Engineer More Sacrifices adds 5 in Runic Blueprint and 5 in Sun Scroll, and the Act 2 Hard card adds 4 at 0 stars up to 12 at 4 stars. Both More Sacrifices upgrades maxed and the Act 2 Hard card at 3 stars give a cap of 40. Reaching 42 needs the card at 4 stars (600 cards at 1 in 50,000, about 30 million kills before bonuses) with the 4 Star Cards upgrade. Wish for Speed always stops at 20.
Players reach the sacrifice cap at 42 (max) at about the time the Hunter damage trainings are at 36.
Level L costs 500 x 1.3^(L-1) of the material plus 250 + 50 x (L-1) ash. Wish for Gold is cheaper in material: 50 x 1.11^(L-1). Engineer Humble Sacrifices adds a 5% chance per level to refund half.
Farm Helmets (best with a Rogue or Mage) for Attack Wish; farm Snowmen for Carrots (Wish for Hardness) and the Snowman card.

tables.title: Sacrifice lines
rows: Cutting Edge Technology: woodcutting power, x0.1
Wish for Hardness: physical defence, x0.05
Wish for Speed: attack speed, +0.5% (cap 20, so 10%)
Mining Edge Technology: mining power, x0.1
